To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

cooperative design requires an integrated document architecture that provides global, interstructure-orientated documents and a network infrastructure that supports QoS driven services for cooperative applications.
the requirements of cooperative design are not yet met by current network technology and by current document architectures.
cooperative design requires a global, interstructure-orientated document architecture and that network technology should be QoS-driven.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a cooperative design environment where the communication technology and the document architecture are adjusted with each other.
the question: What is the impact of cooperative design on document architectures and network technology?
the design of an integrated document architecture and the development of network services to support cooperative design.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the current network and document architectures do not provide the necessary support for cooperation in design.
the requirements on a network technology are strongly related to the requirements on an integrated document structure and vice versa.
the requirements for a network architecture are derived from the needs of a cooperative design application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an integrated view on the requirements of cooperative design on the technical and methodical level.
the requirements for a network infrastructure for cooperative applications are not only the traditional ones, i.e. reliability and security, but also the support of a QoS-driven communication.
we need a network architecture with QoS support and a document architecture with a strong emphasis on inter-structure links.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a cooperative design environment has to be based on a flexible architecture that is able to support different kinds of cooperative applications and to adapt itself dynamically to the actual needs of the users.
a cooperative environment has to be designed as an integrated whole, i.e. as a network of cooperating applications, a set of cooperating documents, and a network of cooperating communication streams.
the requirements on the technical infrastructure are strongly dependent on the requirements on the method level.
